dev.docsTitle: Mini documentation: how to publish your pack
dev.docsStep1: 1. Build your modpack in Prism Launcher (or MultiMC): add mods, shaders, configure the profile and make sure the game launches.
dev.docsStep2: 2. Export the pack: Prism Launcher → Instance → Export → Modrinth pack (.mrpack). You get a single .mrpack file.
dev.docsStep3: 3. Create a GitHub repository and upload the pack to a release: Releases → Create a new release → attach the .mrpack and pack.json files → Publish release. The release tag is the pack version.
dev.docsStep4: 4. pack.json is the pack description: name, version, description. See the minimal file below (the name and version fields are required).
dev.docsStep5: 5. Copy the repository link (e.g. https://github.com/USER/REPO) or the .mrpack file link and paste it into “Add pack” (or press “+” next to the pack list on the left).
dev.docsStep6: 6. Done: the pack appears for you and for all launcher players — they can install and play it.
dev.docsExample: Download the example pack on GitHub
dev.docsNews: Pack news: enable Discussions in the repository (Settings → Discussions) — posts will appear in the launcher news feed. A pack update is a new release with a .mrpack and pack.json file.
dev.docsBugs: Player bug reports land in your repository Issues: the "Report a bug" button in the launcher opens a form pre-filled with the environment (pack version, Minecraft, launcher, OS).
dev.docsContent: Content (optional): servers and socials — servers.json and socials.json in the repository root: the "Servers" tab gets a pack servers section ({ name, ip, port, desc }), the pack header shows social links ({ name, url }). Launcher theme colors — theme.json: when the pack is opened the launcher smoothly tints in author colors (keys: bg, panel, input, border, tx, txStrong, txMuted, accent, accentStrong, accentHover, accentDeep — any hex colors #rrggbb). Screenshots are taken from the player's own screenshots folder (F2 in game). The pack header shows repository stars. Format below:
dev.docsDeep: Invite link: one link for all players. If the launcher is installed, the pack is added automatically; otherwise the page offers to download the launcher. Format: n1orio.github.io/mono-launcher/?url=<pack address>. Put it in README, release notes and Discord.
